CommunityApplications.Profile:
Official Unraid templates for **Silo** — a self-hosted media server for films and series.
Point Silo at your media shares and stream to your devices at home or away, with direct play, remuxing and hardware-accelerated transcoding handled automatically. A full web client and admin interface ship with the server, and an optional Jellyfin/Emby-compatible API lets you keep using clients such as Infuse, VidHub and Findroid.
The **Silo** template uses the AIO image with bundled PostgreSQL and Redis. No separate service containers are required for a new installation. Meilisearch is off by default; Advanced View provides service controls and optional external database and Redis connection URLs.
The **Silo-PostgreSQL** template remains available for installations that manage PostgreSQL separately. Existing installations need a data migration before switching to the bundled database; changing the image tag does not move the old data. See the repository README before updating.
Support is via Discord or GitHub Issues.
